svg.text: outside of the back sill 700 mm from the shaft centre;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one M12 bolt through the sill as a second fixing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: belt guard, welded to the arm and the lever.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: about 250 mm; idler axle 16 mm, 62 mm long.
